translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: I predicted that, so this was very surprising for me too.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: For the first time in a while, everyone gathered

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: and the mood was gloomy.

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: but he didn't show up... I wonder what's wrong...」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「あっ、それならね……

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「If he loses, he trains to become even stronger.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 分かりやすい奴だからな」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: He's straightforward like that.」

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「それに……
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Besides...

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: He probably doesn't want to show everyone his frustrated side.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 今日は放っておいてやろう」
translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: Let's leave him be today.」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「Like some dog...」

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: 「More importantly, the problem is――

translationLines.translatedEnglishLine: stood next to an oddly cheerful Hani-ko.

translationLines.originalJapaneseLine: 「まっ、長い人生、
